What you say !! Everyone hates him, everyone loves him. Will he show up in yousa Light Side deck? Sure, whysa not? The clumsy Gungan can potentially fumble his way into any place, no matter how secure the location may be. He can trip his way into the [[Endor: Bunker]] even if [[Ephant Mon]] is guarding the place. He can waltz right into the Emperor's [[Death Star II: Throne Room]] -- followed by his Enhanced friends with permanent weapons to dispatch the Emperor. Also, Jar Jar's game text can be handy in battle. Just like the movie, he can put someone out of commission. Upset and missing Jar Jar after his latest catastrophe? No problem. Along with her Jedi protectors, this leader of the Queen's Guard is handy to have around – especially to pick off unwanted characters. [[Captain Panaka]] may not have Jedi stats, but his game text and matching weapon say enough. Put [[Panaka's Blaster]] on him and he fires it for free, draws weapon destiny +2, and, if he hits, your opponent loses 2 Force. Pretty sharp shootin'! The real kicker? He gets his matching weapon from Reserve Deck! Now that's card efficiency. His stats are like [[General Solo]] or [[Grand Moff Tarkin{{!}}Tarkin]], making him a strong character. All for deploy of 4, or 3 at Amidala's location, and a forfeit of 6. You might just find a reason to make some room for this sharpshooter – and his gun – in your deck. '''Virtual Legacy''' — [[Coruscant: Jedi Council Chamber (V)]] (1250_72) |sources=* [https://web.archive.org/web/20081225225012/http://www.decipher.com/starwars/cardlists/index.html Star Wars CCG cardlists index] at Decipher.com (archive, 25 December 2008) * [https://web.archive.org/web/20070928014432/http://www.decipher.com/starwars/cardlists/swallcards.pdf Complete Card List] (Decipher PDF, archive 28 September 2007) — Light Location: Coruscant: Jedi Council Chamber, Coruscant, R |strategy=By Doug Taylorhttps://web.archive.org/web/20040811123219/http://www.decipher.com/starwars/cardlists/coruscant/light/small/coruscantjedicouncilchamber.html It's been 5 years since the game has seen the introduction of a 3/0 location. Back in 1996, the Dark Side got the [[Death Star (Special Edition){{!}}Death Star]] system in [[A New Hope]]. Now, the Light Side gets the first 3/0 site to balance things out. Any location that is so incredible for generating Force serves as a two-edged sword and poses a great danger for the person playing it. One must be extremely cautious to not allow it to fall into enemy hands, lest those 3 icons of Force-generating goodness be turned into a painful Force drain of 3 each turn. Fortunately, this new Light side mega-Force engine is custom-built to be the staging ground for the powerful and mysterious Jedi Council. Most of the Council members are completely immune to attrition there, and many cannot deploy anywhere else. Many of the strongest mechanics of these members (like those of [[Mace Windu]] and [[Depa Billaba]]) function only when that Jedi Master is contemplating the universe from within the sacred chambers. Another great feature of this locale is the ability to "download" [[Yoda, Senior Council Member]], who can then act to disperse your Jedi around the galaxy and augment your forces elsewhere. Combos: Use the Council Chamber as your "other [E1] location" on the Senator Objective to start yourself out with 4 Force icons while giving your opponent only 1. Use this Interrupt to deploy your JCC, or (once it's out) to get those Jedi Council members out of your deck and into the Council Chamber where they belong. |combos=* [[Coruscant: Jedi Council Chamber]] + [[Plead My Case To The Senate / Sanity And Compassion{{!}}Plead My Case To The Senate]] Objective[https://scomp.starwarsccg.org/?s=Coruscant%3A%20Jedi%20Council%20Chamber Scomp: Coruscant: Jedi Council Chamber]; card data [https://github.com/swccgpc/swccg-card-json/blob/d4e661ec/Light.json swccg-card-json Light.json] (commit d4e661ec).
